bodyHtml: We are excited to announce that we will be moving our Columbus office into a larger space!  We will be in the new office beginning 8/1/2020, so any appointments scheduled at the Parkmead Drive office after 8/1/2020 will actually occur at the new location, which is less than a mile away at 2041 Stringtown Road Grove City, Ohio 43123.  It’s located in a medical office complex directly behind the Sherwin Williams store that is visible on the south side of Stringtown Road, in between I-75 and the old location on Parkmead.
